# Refuse transfers over the daily limit

As a Portal customer I want transfers that would take me over my daily limit refused so that a stolen login can't drain my account in one day.

## Acceptance criteria

- Given an account with a limit of 1000 that has sent 900 today, when it asks to send 200, then the transfer is refused with LIMIT_EXCEEDED (HTTP 422) and nothing is posted. (specs/transfer-limits/spec.md:6)
- Given an account with a limit of 1000 that has sent 900 today, when it asks to send 100, then the transfer is accepted. (specs/transfer-limits/spec.md:10)
